content: Framework comparison (community, LOW): Fastify 5.12 fastest on Node with schema-first plugins; NestJS 12 heavy DI/decorators for large teams; Hono 4.13 lightweight Web-standard, runs on Node via @hono/node-server 2.x (node>=20), ships RPC client (hc) for end-to-end types and @hono/zod-openapi 1.6 (zod ^4, hono>=4.10) for OpenAPI; in I/O-bound apps framework overhead is negligible.
